description: Have WordPressBuilder design a NEW WordPress site from a description — 'a gardening blog with a contact page'. The result is a DRAFT with pages, menu and texts; it goes onto the server when the user presses 'Set up' in the cockpit — tell them so. Needs a free WordPress place in the plan and uses the AI quota. For changes to an existing WordPress site use create_wordpress_task.

brief.description: Who the site is for and what it should show (10–2000 characters).

with_brand.description: True: the site follows the account's brand.

name: create_wordpress_site
title: Design a WordPress site (AI)
